d: Hackers targeted refrigeration systems linked to France’s national blood service and attempted to push storage temperatures to dangerous levels. The French Blood Service supplies more than 1,900 hospitals and supports more than one million patients every year, making it a critical part of the country’s healthcare infrastructure. Hackers reportedly gained access through a supplier and manipulated temperature controls at least three cold-storage facilities. Alarms alerted staff before any blood was spoiled.
